sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the c
 following:

Order 
This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.313/2021, registered at Police Station Sohagpur, District Shahdol (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 342, 363, 376(3) and 376(2)(n) of IPC and under Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
Applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed vide order dated 07.11.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.50974/2022.
A s prayed by learned counsel for the applicant, this second bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed on behalf of applicant - Lallu Baiga is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
